visa_routes.name: Express Entry (Federal Skilled Worker / Canadian Experience Class) – permanent residence

salary_threshold.note: No salary threshold; ranked by Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS) score. Proof of settlement funds required for FSW without valid job offer (amount not read this session).

visa_routes.degree_requirement: No degree mandatory, but education earns CRS points; foreign education needs an Educational Credential Assessment (ECA) from a designated body (e.g. WES).
visa_routes.three_year_indian_bachelors_note: CRS awards the same points to a 'bachelor's degree OR a three or more year program' (120 points single / 112 with spouse) as long as the ECA confirms it, so a 3-year Indian bachelor's is not penalised versus a 4-year one in CRS. Two-year credentials earn 98/91. The ECA result for the specific program decides.
visa_routes.lottery_or_quota: Not a lottery: periodic invitation rounds by CRS score, increasingly by category (STEM, French, healthcare, trades, etc.). Category draws in 2026 require 12 months of experience in the category (up from 6). Recent general/CEC cut-offs reported above 500, hard for offshore candidates without Canadian experience or French.
visa_routes.employer_cost_note: No employer needed. Applicant pays IRCC fees, language test (IELTS/CELPIP), ECA.

visa_routes.name: Global Talent Stream (LMIA-based work permit), Category B

salary_threshold.note: For NOC 21231/21232/21234/21211 the employer must pay at least the prevailing wage (highest of regional median Job Bank wage, wage paid to current staff, or Category minimum). Category A (referral-based) minimums: CA$80,000 for first 2 positions/year, CA$150,000 thereafter.

visa_routes.degree_requirement: No statutory degree requirement for the LMIA; work-permit officer checks the worker meets the job requirements.
visa_routes.three_year_indian_bachelors_note: Not a formal barrier for the work permit; later PR via Express Entry uses the ECA (3-year program = bachelor's-level CRS points).
visa_routes.processing_time: ESDC service standard reported as 10 business days for the LMIA (secondary sources: 8-12 days in 2026); work permit processed separately by IRCC.
visa_routes.path_to_pr: Canadian work experience (1 year) enables Canadian Experience Class in Express Entry; provincial nominee programs also possible.
visa_routes.employer_cost_note: Employer pays CA$1,000 LMIA fee per position (cannot be paid by or recovered from the worker) and must commit to a Labour Market Benefits Plan with annual reviews.

visa_routes.name: Intra-company transferee work permit (LMIA-exempt)
visa_routes.degree_requirement: Not researched in this session; generally requires recent continuous employment with the foreign related company.
visa_routes.path_to_pr: Canadian experience counts toward Express Entry CEC.
visa_routes.employer_cost_note: Employer compliance fee applies for LMIA-exempt offers (amount not read).

sponsor_register.name: TFWP Positive Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA) Employers List (ESDC, Open Government Portal)
sponsor_register.update_frequency: Quarterly (latest 2026 Q2 = Apr-Jun 2026, published 2026-10-30). Older releases CSV.
sponsor_register.how_to_use: Download the latest quarterly XLSX (e.g. tfwp_2026q2_pos_en.xlsx), filter rows by program stream (Global Talent / High-wage) and NOC 2021 codes 21231/21232/21234/21211, then fuzzy-match normalised employer names (lowercase, strip Inc/Ltd/Corp/Ltée, punctuation). Positive LMIA = employer recently approved to hire a foreign worker; it does not cover LMIA-exempt hires (ICT etc.) and omits personal-name employers. Licence: Open Government Licence – Canada.

ease_for_indian_nationals.rationale: Express Entry needs no employer and treats a 3-year bachelor's like a 4-year one for CRS, but offshore candidates without Canadian experience or French face high cut-offs and STEM draws have been scarce. With an employer, the Global Talent Stream is fast (~2 weeks LMIA) for software NOCs, but employers must pay CA$1,000 and commit to a benefits plan, so few sponsor from abroad.

factors.degree_recognition: Good: 3-year program scores as bachelor's in CRS once ECA done.
factors.language_barrier: None for English; French is a bonus.
factors.processing_speed: GTS LMIA ~10 business days; PR via Express Entry months.
factors.quota_or_lottery: No lottery; competitive CRS ranking and annual levels plan.
factors.employer_willingness: Moderate; mostly larger tech firms and scale-ups use GTS.
factors.attestation_or_paperwork: ECA, IELTS/CELPIP, police certificates, proof of funds (FSW).

scam_warnings: Paying for an LMIA or a job offer: the LMIA fee cannot be paid by or recovered from the worker (ESDC). 'LMIA for sale' offers are fraud.
Consultants promising guaranteed Express Entry invitations; only licensed RCICs or lawyers may charge for immigration advice.
Fake job offers on chat apps asking for 'processing fees' or medical/insurance deposits.
Phishing that impersonates IRCC/ESDC; check that links are on canada.ca.
